none: PAS LON-B7EEB4: Roman ceramic rim sherd from a Verulamium region white ware mortarium with maker’s stamp
contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman ceramic rim sherd from a Verulamium region white ware mortarium with maker's stamp dating AD50-140. This sherd includes part of the hooked flange and the section of the rim with a maker's stamp. The stamp is unclear it may read "FECIT" or "LEG-" within a herringbone border. The fabric is very mud-stained but originally would have been the distinctive white fabric. Dimensions: weight:…
